final_message: Docs-site now copies each declared repository's `docs/ja/product/` to `/ja/product/<name>/`, applying the local config's `repos` overrides. It adds one sidebar section per repository, and wikilinks from project docs resolve by reading ids from frontmatter at build time (also as `<name>:<id>`). A missing repository is skipped with a warning and the build continues. Output is unchanged when no project declares `repos`. Unit tests, the guide, the config reference and the README are updated; the ticket records the work, decisions and CHANGELOG draft. The real site build was not run; the trial build after integration is left open for the orchestrator.
handoff: Doc index decision: ids of imported product docs are not added to `.specdojo/doc-index.json`. Docs-site reads them from frontmatter (`specdojo.id`, or else a top-level `id`) at build time and adds them only to the site's index. Reason: `specdojo index build` is shared with agents and plans, so mixing in site-only product paths has wide impact, and repositories that are not checked out then affect only the site, with no index rebuild.

On an id collision the project's doc index wins, with a warning; between repositories the first one wins. Ids without `:` also resolve as `<repo-name>:<id>`. YAML docs resolve only when their yaml-pages generated page (`generated/<name>.md`, which is git-untracked) is present in the product repository.

Other decisions: when several projects declare the same `name`, the first in project-id order wins. If the project repository itself has `docs/ja/product/<name>/`, the project's docs win and that repository's import is skipped with a warning. `dev` does not sync product-side edits; restart the server to pick them up.

Remaining risk: an imported doc that links relatively outside `docs/ja/product/` (for example `../../projects/...`) sits one level deeper in the staging tree, becomes a dead link and fails the build. VitePress `ignoreDeadLinks` cannot filter by source page, so this is not handled. Check it in the orchestrator's trial build and open a separate item if needed.

Left for the orchestrator after integration: build the site with a trial repository that declares `repos` and confirm the `/ja/product/<name>/` pages and sidebar section appear before close (ticket work item 5 is left `open`).

No protected-configuration change is needed. `packages/docs-site/package.json` version and `CHANGELOG.md` are unchanged. The CHANGELOG category (Added, @specdojo/docs-site) and line draft are in the ticket's 'CHANGELOG に書く事項' subsection.
